feeds.title: Mysportscience

feeds.title: Martin Buchheit

feeds.title: Mr Salus Sporting Lab Blog
feeds.description: Mr Salus Sporting Lab is a blog dedicated to providing readers with valuable information about sports performance, fitness, and health. The blog covers topics such as strength training, endurance training, nutrition, and injury prevention. While information is presented in a casual, easy-to-understand format, the blog is based on solid scientific research.

feeds.title: HRVtraining
feeds.description: I am Andrew, read all the blog posts to get all the valuable information on sports science, and in turn improve your performance in the field of sports. HRVtraining is a blog dedicated to heart rate variability (HRV) training, which is a technique used to monitor and optimize athletes' training and recovery.

feeds.title: ScienceDaily » Sports Science News
feeds.description: ScienceDaily is a website that provides readers with the latest news and research in sports science. The site covers a wide range of topics, from the latest research on concussion prevention to the benefits of exercise for mental health.

feeds.title: TrainingPeaks Blog
feeds.description: TrainingPeaks is a blog dedicated to providing athletes and coaches with the latest information on sports science and training techniques. The blog covers topics such as nutrition, strength training, and recovery, and is backed by a team of experts in the field.

feeds.title: Science for Sport Blog
feeds.description: Science for Sport is a company that provides science-based information, education, and consultancy services to sports coaches and athletes. Their blog provides information and advice on various topics related to sports science, including physiology, nutrition, and psychology.

feeds.title: Stronger by Science

The mission of the blog is to bridge the gap between science and practice in strength training and other related areas.

feeds.title: Exercise Right Blog
feeds.description: Exercise Right is an Australian-based organization that promotes the benefits of physical activity and exercise for overall health and wellbeing. Their blog provides information and resources related to exercise science, fitness, and physical activity. The organization's mission is to empower individuals to make positive changes in their lives through physical activity and exercise.

feeds.title: Science In Sport
feeds.description: Founded in 1992, Science in Sport (SiS) is a sports nutrition company that offers a range of products designed to help athletes and active individuals optimize their performance. Their blog provides science-based information and advice on various topics related to sports nutrition and training.

feeds.title: Global Performance Insights Blog

Their blog covers a range of topics related to sports science and performance analysis, including the latest research, trends, and techniques in the field.

The blog provides insights on how yoga can benefit athletes, covering topics such as injury prevention, mental health, and recovery.

feeds.title: Sport Performance & Science Reports » Sport Science

feeds.title: Footballscience.net
